summary:
I checked SL-106 against two real environments.

**Real SMB client, in Windows Sandbox (build 26100).** I published a scratch console built on this slice's own FsAnalyser.Core. It also linked the App's UnreadableRows, TopLevelRowText and FolderTreeSession. It scanned a share served by the repo's SmbRig through the real Windows SMB client. I ran it in two sandboxes.
- Folder s: CREATE returned STATUS_SUCCESS, then its first QUERY_DIRECTORY was held and the server stopped. It was stamped win32 59, OpenedNothingListed, ChildCount 0. The list, the tree lookup and the top-level title all said 'opened, but nothing could be listed'.
- Folder a: the server refused its open. It stayed 5, NothingListed, 'could not be opened' on all three surfaces.
- Folder t: its open came after the server was gone. It read 53, NothingListed.
- Root: CREATE succeeded and its first directory query was held, then the server stopped. The scan ended RootUnreadable 59 with no record.
- No SMB mapping was left behind.

**Real folders on this PC, through the published exe.** W-001 over C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Local\Temp\fsa-guard-tests read 27 rows, all code 363 and all NothingListed. That is 0 OpenedNothingListed, so those folders still read 'could not be opened'.

**Checks run here:**
- Build: 0 warnings.
- Full suite: 964/964.
- Bug projects SL-063 (10/10), SL-084 (1/1), SL-100 (29/29) and SL-105 (1/1) all pass.
- T-007 passed: P reads 'only partly read'; R reads 'could not be opened' through the session lookup.
- T-003 passed (Q-128).
- WindowMutants -Mutant All killed all 12 mutants (Q-114).
- Fitness: all 94 rules hold.
- rules-parity: AGREE 18/22/48.
- RuleCases C-001 and C-003 hold.
- rules harness F52/F29/F30: AS-RECORDED, firing in both xUnit and Fitness.

**Criteria not checked.** The design itself marked criterion 11 not material: drawing the OpenedNothingListed note in the published app's tree. No published-exe run draws that note, because FailListingOf still refuses page 1. Criterion 14 was also marked not material; I measured it only through the scratch driver in the Sandbox. The acceptance reproduction was not re-run; the engine's exit 0 stands.

checks.what: Published exe, T-003: cold and warm open of a 100,000-child folder (Q-128)
checks.evidence: PASSED: T-003. Warm opens took 1.8-4.1 ms with 46 rows built, under the 500 ms bar.

checks.what: Real Windows SMB client (Sandbox 26100), this slice's Core plus the App's word and lookup sources: refused open, opened-then-first-query-failed, and a control
checks.command: Sandbox run-20261013-045637: .taad-scratch/validate/SmbPhase (SmbRig LoopbackShare, DenyAtOpen=a, StopAnsweringAtTheListingOf(s), then SMBServer.Stop 500 ms after the hold), run as local admin through schtasks
checks.evidence:
Control: only a was unreadable (5, NothingListed, 'could not be opened'); s was Done with 3 files.
Stall: the rig logged 'create s STATUS_SUCCESS' then 'hold s'. Result: UNREADABLE s win32=59 kind=OpenedNothingListed childCount=0. Tree note: 'opened, but nothing could be listed'. List: '...\s - opened, but nothing could be listed: network or share error'. TOP s: state Unreadable, failedKind OpenedNothingListed, title 's  (opened, but nothing could be listed)'.
a: 5, NothingListed, 'could not be opened' on all three surfaces. t: 53, NothingListed.
mappings-after: empty.

checks.what: Repeat of the SMB stall run in a second fresh Sandbox
checks.evidence: Same result: s is 59, OpenedNothingListed, ChildCount 0, worded the same on all three surfaces; a is 5 and t is 53, both NothingListed. Elapsed 6635 ms, status Completed.

checks.what: Criterion 14 on the real SMB client: the root's CREATE succeeds and its first directory query is held, then fails
checks.evidence: Four 'create <root> STATUS_SUCCESS' lines, then 'hold' on the root. STATUS RootUnreadable, rootError 59, unreadable 0, files 0, folders 0. The rig traces only creates, so it is not logged which root handle the held query ran on.

checks.what: Architecture rules, including the two settled rules this slice appended
checks.evidence: 94 rule(s) checked against 174 parsed file(s), 238 file(s) read. Every declared rule holds.
rules-parity: AGREE 18 facts <- 22 twinned entries, 48 patterns; 72 settled entries not compared. Exit 0.

checks.what: The widened TheAppNeverDecidesAFailedFolderKind fires on a planted ternary over OpenedNothingListed, in both engines
checks.evidence: Clean baseline: xunit 18 Facts with 0 hits; fitness 0 hits. F29, F30 and F52 each fire/fire and fire/fire, AS-RECORDED. 0 stray hits, exit 0. One import rule is NOT RUN in the scratch copy because it has no code graph; this was already the case before this slice.

checks.what: RuleCases C-001 and C-003 (the settled counts move with the two appended rules)
checks.evidence: Both exit 0. Both shells give AGREE 18/22/48 with 72 settled entries. C-003's appended-below-marker case gives 73 settled; the above-marker case gives DRIFT 1 unpaired, as intended.

checks.what: No surface works the kind out from ChildCount any more
checks.command: git diff c6d43e0 HEAD -- src/ ; Grep ChildCount in src/FsAnalyser.App and src/FsAnalyser.Core/TopLevelTracker.cs
checks.evidence: Note now reads _session.FailedKind(_entry) and words it through KindText. TitleOf words row.FailedKind through KindText. TopLevelTracker stores OwnFailed = failed, passed in from Scanner.FailedKind, and holds no ChildCount reference. In the App, ChildCount is left only in FolderTreeNode:50, :106 and :159 (openable and the expander), not in any wording.

checks.what: N-005's expectations for s were not broken by the new kind
checks.evidence: The control checks s's reason only ('network or share error'), never its kind. The main run requires s to be no row at all. CheckSeamRow has words for all three kinds and fails a kind it has no words for. N-005 itself was not run: it changes SMB mappings on the host.

checks.what: Criterion 11: the published app drawing an OpenedNothingListed tree note
checks.evidence: The design marked this row material:false: FailListingOf refuses page 1, and relaxing it touches the high-risk SynchronousIoCancel.cs. No published-exe path makes the note. Only its parts were exercised: the session lookup plus KindText on a real SMB OpenedNothingListed folder in the Sandbox, and the drawn Note-through-lookup path in T-007 for the other two kinds.

checks.what: Opt-in Network=SMB-LOOPBACK and Network=TEST-NET-1 xUnit filters
checks.evidence: SMB-LOOPBACK changes SMB mappings on the host. The design filed it as a person's run, and the Sandbox driver above covered the phase this slice changes. TEST-NET-1: the build reported 2 failures that also fail identically on HEAD c6d43e0 in an extracted copy. I did not re-run it.
The engine ran it and recorded exit 0 (O-001). Per the stage rules I did not re-run it or give an opinion on it.

criteria.criterion: 1. record and word a folder whose open is refused (deny ListDirectory, error 5), so nothing is listed
criteria.how: The suite passes, including UnreadableFolderTests and the bug test's control half. T-007 shows R as 'could not be opened' in the published exe. On the real Windows SMB client in the Sandbox, a (refused at CREATE) is 5, NothingListed, 'could not be opened' on the list, the tree lookup and the top-level title.

criteria.criterion: 2. record and word a folder whose open succeeds and whose first page fails with 59 (ChildCount 0)
criteria.how: The engine's acceptance run exited 0 (O-001). The Core Facts pass in the 964-test suite. In the Sandbox, twice, the real SMB client opened s (create STATUS_SUCCESS), its first QUERY_DIRECTORY was held and the server stopped. s was stamped 59, OpenedNothingListed, ChildCount 0, and all three surfaces said 'opened, but nothing could be listed'.

criteria.criterion: 3. a keep-last-access open is refused (deny WriteAttributes), the plain fallback opens the folder, and its first page fails with 59
criteria.how: UnreadableFolderTests.AFolderOpenedByTheFallbackAfterItsKeepOpenWasRefusedIsOpenedNothingListedWhenItsFirstPageFails passes in the 964/964 suite. It runs on real NTFS with a real deny ACE. I did not re-apply the build's hand mutation.

criteria.criterion: 4. listing fails at page 2 after entries were kept, so the folder is listed partway
criteria.how: T-007 on the published exe: P reads 'only partly read', with an expander, keeping 355 of 2000 files. TopLevelRowTextTests and CancelledFolderTests pass in the suite.

criteria.criterion: 5. stamp the kind from the phase: 995 with cancel requested, versus 995 on a first page with no cancel issued
criteria.how: ScannerFailedKindTests passes in the 964/964 suite. I did not run it separately.

criteria.criterion: 6. a refused open with a code other than 5: 32, 363, 1920
criteria.how: Real dataset: W-001 through the published exe over this PC's fsa-guard-tests read 27 rows, all code 363 and NothingListed, with 0 OpenedNothingListed. ScannerFailedKindTests and HeldFolderReasonTests (real 32) pass. Code 1920 is covered by unit rows only.

criteria.criterion: 7. leave out the container layer store, by the walk's check or the reader's InsideExcludedStore backstop
criteria.how: ContainerLayerStoreTests, which now assert Opened, pass in the 964/964 suite.

criteria.criterion: 8. word every member of UnreadableKind, plus an unnamed value
criteria.how: UnreadableRowsTests passes in the suite. Reading UnreadableRows.KindText: one arm per member, and null or unnamed values give 'could not be read'.

criteria.criterion: 9. look up a tree row's kind: an entry in the record, not in it, held twice, and a closed session
criteria.how: FolderTreeSessionTests passes in the suite. The real-SMB Sandbox run also built FolderTreeSession(result.Store, result.Unreadable) and got the stamped kind for a, s and t.

criteria.criterion: 10. draw the folder tree's note in the published app: P listed partway and R denied outright, in one tree
criteria.how: WindowCases.ps1 -Case T-007 passed against the published exe: P reads 'only partly read'; R reads 'could not be opened' with no expander.

criteria.criterion: 11. draw the folder tree's note in the published app for an opened-then-failed folder (OpenedNothingListed)
criteria.how: The design marked this row material:false: FailListingOf refuses page 1, so no published-exe path draws it. Only its parts were exercised: the session lookup plus KindText on a real SMB OpenedNothingListed folder (Sandbox), and the drawn Note-through-lookup path for the other two kinds (T-007). FolderTreeNode.Note in a drawn window was never seen giving 'opened, but nothing could be listed'.

criteria.criterion: 12. classify a panel row in W-001's oracle: an OpenedNothingListed row, code 5, whose folder lists now
criteria.how: W001OracleTests (corpus row F16) passes in the 964/964 suite. The real W-001 run also passed its new 'every row is NothingListed, OpenedNothingListed or ListedPartway' check.

criteria.criterion: 13. keep the App from deciding the kind, with the rule copies agreeing: a planted ternary over OpenedNothingListed, plus two engine-appended settled rules
criteria.how: Rules harness --only F52 is AS-RECORDED, firing in both xUnit and Fitness. Fitness: 94 rules hold, including both settled rules. rules-parity is AGREE 18/22/48. RuleCases C-001 and C-003 exit 0.

criteria.criterion: 14. record a scan whose root opens and whose first listing page fails with nothing listed
criteria.how: Real SMB client in the Sandbox: four root CREATEs returned STATUS_SUCCESS, then the root's first directory query was held and the server stopped. Result: RootUnreadable, rootError 59, 0 unreadable records, no top-level rows. This matches the design's not-material note that the root never reaches the stamp. The rig traces only creates, so it is not logged which root handle the held query ran on.

obligations.evidence:
1. The grep and diff show ChildCount no longer feeds Note, TitleOf or the tracker's kind. Note reads _session.FailedKind; TitleOf reads row.FailedKind through KindText; TopLevelTracker stores OwnFailed from the passed-in stamp and holds no ChildCount reference. ChildCount stays in the App only for openable and the expander.
2. Fitness reports 94 rules holding, including 'in Core, only the scanner names a failed folder's kind' and 'in the App, only UnreadableRows writes a failed folder's kind in words'.
3. The rules harness --only F52 is AS-RECORDED: the planted ternary over OpenedNothingListed fires in both xUnit and Fitness.
On the real SMB client (Sandbox), the three surfaces agreed for NothingListed (a, t) and OpenedNothingListed (s). T-007 shows the drawn tree agreeing for ListedPartway (P) and NothingListed (R).

not_reached: The published WPF exe never drew an OpenedNothingListed tree note or top-level title: FailListingOf still refuses page 1 (criterion 11, marked not material by the design). The new kind was seen through the scratch driver composing Core with the App's KindText, TopLevelRowText and FolderTreeSession, not in a drawn window.
The opt-in Network=SMB-LOOPBACK xUnit suite was not run on this build. It changes SMB mappings on the host and was filed as a person's run. The Sandbox driver exercised the changed phase only.
Host Windows 11 build 26200's SMB redirector: the real-SMB measurement ran in a Sandbox on build 26100. Windows 10 was not measured.
A production SMB server (Windows Server, Samba, a NAS) that accepts CREATE and then fails the first QUERY_DIRECTORY: the server was the repo's SMBLibrary rig.
N-005 itself (the published exe on the stall rig): not run on the host because it changes SMB mappings. Its checks were read and do not pin s's kind.
--filter Network=TEST-NET-1 was not re-run. The build reported 2 failures that fail identically on HEAD c6d43e0.
